desc:
🦖 Welcome to Totally Safe Dino Park! 🦖

Team up with up to 4 friends and run your own dino park! 🏝️

🍖 Feed the dinos before they get hungry
💩 Scoop up poop and throw it in the generator
⚡ Keep the power on or the fences go down
🎟️ Sell tickets and souvenirs to guests
🚨 Dino escaped? Tranq it!
⭐ Survive multiple days to unlock new dinos like the Long-Neck and Raptors!

🪙 Earn Dino Coins every day
🎰 Spin for dino vests and helmets with boosts
😱 Jumpscare your friends

Can your crew keep the park open... or will everyone get eaten? 🦕

If you liked the game, please give it a like! ❤️
